$comment: Permissions for a benchmark cell. A cell runs unattended, so it cannot answer a prompt, and the obvious way to achieve that was --dangerously-skip-permissions. That flag also disables a plugin's PreToolUse hooks, which are the framework's scope guard, rate limiting and non-destructive denylist, so every cell measured the framework without its enforcement. Pre-granting the tools here instead keeps the hooks live: verified by the guard firing on a bare curl in a cell configured this way, and staying silent under the flag.
